item.title: WATCH: Ex-NATO chief draws red line as Trump fumes alliance abandoned US during Iran war
item.summary: Former NATO chief Jens Stoltenberg says the alliance should not be drawn into supporting U.S. military operations against Iran, calling NATO defensive.

item.title: Iran threatens to halt Red Sea traffic in response to US military blockade of ports
item.summary: Iran's military warns it could block exports and imports in the Red Sea, Persian Gulf and Sea of Oman if the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports is not lifted.

item.title: House Dems launch impeachment push against Hegseth
item.summary: Thirteen House Democrats filed six articles of impeachment against Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, accusing him of war crimes and reckless handling of classified information.

item.title: Nick Shirley warns California bill could punish people trying to expose government fraud
item.summary: A proposed California bill aims to protect immigration support providers, but critics claim it could shield fraudsters from citizen investigations.

item.title: ‘Privileged’ Hunter Biden, spared by dad’s pardon, blasts Trump’s clemency power
item.summary: Hunter Biden admits his own bias regarding the presidential pardon from his father, claiming the founders never imagined Donald Trump or his family.

item.title: Maniac who stabbed boy outside Walmart was previously freed after attacking dad, church rampage: report
item.summary: A Nebraska woman fatally shot by police after allegedly cutting a boy at a Walmart had prior felony charges for allegedly stabbing her father in 2024.

item.title: DHS shutdown enters Day 60 with all eyes on House Republicans to end it
item.summary: Congress returned with no end in sight for the 60-day DHS shutdown as Republicans eye a "skinny" reconciliation bill to fund immigration enforcement.

item.title: Fed-up dumpster company empties full load onto lawn of customer they say refused to pay bill
item.summary: Ring doorbell footage captured a California dumpster company emptying trash on a San Pablo homeowner's lawn over what they claim is an unpaid bill.

item.title: David Axelrod trying to tamp down speculation after meeting the pope
item.summary: David Axelrod denies his Pope Leo XIV meeting was a precursor to a potential summit with former President Barack Obama amid accusations of politically motivated Trump criticism.

item.title: Over a dozen state officials rally behind game-changing Trump admin rule cracking down on fraud: 'Essential'
item.summary: Financial officers from 12 states rally behind a Trump administration rule targeting healthcare middlemen to lower costs and root out fraud and waste.
